posts.title: Leona Wallace, Boss of the Macy's Thanksgiving Parade
posts.description: Family history is being shared by the youngest generation this week! My great nephew is going to tell his second grade class about how our immigrant "Aunt Lee" (Leona Lee Wallace , 1903-1989, original surname Walasyk ) ran the iconic Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. posts.title: The Short Family in the News - A Time of Change
posts.description: In November of 1872, farmer David Oscar Short (1849-1895) married Cornelia Jane Shank (1851-1938). Oscar, as he was usually known, was my husband's 1c3r. He and Cornelia Jane had one daughter, Eleanor Josephine Short (1873-1916). Unfortunately, that was the end of their line, a real change for a family that had so many children in most lines. posts.title: Oldies But Goodies: NARA's Free Genealogy Articles
posts.description: The US National Archives and Records Administration used to publish a quarterly magazine, Prologue , with articles featuring items of historical interest from NARA vaults across the country. Alas, after nearly 50 years, Prologue ceased publication with its Winter 2017-2018 issue.
